RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, August 22, 2012/Sravana 31, 1934 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Culture; Defence; Home Affairs;
Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Labour and Employment; Textiles;
Urban Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Construction of road over Najafgarh
drain
*141. SHRI BHAGA T SINGH
KOSHY ARI: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
refer to answers to Starred Questions 305,
289, Unstarred Questions 858, 2597, 3814
and 1060 given in the Rajya Sabha on the
6th December, 2007, 23rd July, 2009, 6th
September, 2007, 26th November, 2009,
29th April, 2010 and 18th November, 2010
respectively and state:
(a) whether the Delhi Development
Authority (DDA) would align and revisit
the requirement of road linkage in view of
the survey ordered by Delhi Government
to construct the required road over
Najafgarh drain;
(b) whether DDA would reconsider the
proposal to cover Najafgarh drain, to avoid
unnecessary uprooting of existing dwelling
units, besides providing an environmental
friendly way to utilise Najafgarh drain;
(c) if not, the reasons for DDA not
acting in synergy with Delhi Government;
and
(d) the steps being taken to prevent
wastage of tax payers money due to
repetitive work by multiple agenceis?
Investigation into Pune bomb blasts
†*142. SHRI MOHAN SINGH: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
serial bomb blasts took place in Pune,
Maharashtra on 1 August, 2012;
(b) if so, whether its investigation has
been completed; and
(c) the elements suspected to be
involved in these blasts and the steps being
taken by Government to halt their
activities?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

46
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Deplorable condition of archives and
libraries
*143. SHRI SHYAMAL
CHAKRABORTY: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most of the
country's archives and libraries are in a
state of ruin;
(b) if so, the reasons behind this
deplorable condition;
(c) whether Government is
contemplating any plan of action in this
regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Pressure by MNCs to increase FIIs'
participation in retail trade
†*144. SHRI RA VI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several
America based multinational companies are
exerting pressure on their Government to
persuade Indian Government to increase
Foreign Institutional Investors' (FIIs)
participation in retail market in India;
(b) if so, information available with
Government in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that these
companies have spent lakhs of dollars for
this purpose during the quarter ending 30
June; and
(d) whether it is also a fact that due to
opposition to increasing foreign investment
in retail market in India, it is not possible
to grant permission for it?
Separating prison administration
from Police Department
*145. SHRI PARSHOTTAM
KHODABHAI RUPALA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
recently murder of a prisoner took place
in Pune jail;
(b) if so, what action has been taken
by Central Government;
(c) what action has been taken by
Central Government in coordination with
State Governments to prevent crimes
perpetrated in prisons; and
(d) whether Government, in
coordination with State Governments, is
planning to separate prison administration
from Police Department, as this may lead
to more efficiency in prison administration
and may minimize corruption among jail
staff?
Proposal for a minimum monthly
pension of ````` 1000 for EPF subscribers
*146. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the proposal
for a minimum monthly pension of ` 1,000
for Employees Pension Fund (EPF)
subscribers is still under discussion with
the union leaders and the Ministry of
Finance;
(b) whether it is also a fact that EPF
scheme introduced in 1995 remains
unchanged for seventeen long years
without any upward revision in the
pension benefit; and
(c) whether the Ministry will raise it
to at least ` 3,000  in view of the fact that
the cost of living has gone up enormously?

47
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Women in armed forces
*147. DR. K.P. RAMALINGAM:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that women
constitute just 2.84 per cent of the officers
in the Navy, 3.01 per cent in the Army
and 8.55 per cent in the Indian Air Force,
excluding the medical streams, despite
being allowed into the armed forces since
the early 1990s;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government is considering to recruit more
women in all the three forces very soon;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
